description.value: Loblaws is a major Canadian full-service supermarket located in downtown Vancouver's Yaletown/BC Place area at 658 Homer Street. As one of Canada's largest grocery chains, it offers a broad range of food and household products in a large-format store environment. Its central location makes it a convenient resupply stop for cyclists touring or transiting through Vancouver's urban core.
